insights.summary: Front-line teams say AI call summaries save time on callbacks, dispatch and handoffs.
insights.quote: Instead of listening to a whole call, they read the summary & know exactly what the member needed

insights.summary: The Salesforce integration stops writing call data to custom objects when fields or picklist values change.
insights.quote: We changed a picklist value on the Member_Interaction__c object last month, & now some calls aren't writing the outcome to the right place
